_about: AOS-SFR-2026-001 instrument, version 1.0, frozen 16 September 2026 as the sweep of that date wrote it (general-findings/austender-buyer-sweep-2026-09/intermediation.py, dict V). A notice NAMES a vendor when brand_regex matches contracts[].description (case-insensitive); it is DIRECT when supplier_regex matches parties[role=supplier].name (case-insensitive, casefolded) or the last nine digits of the AU-ABN are in acns; INTERMEDIATED when named and not direct. A brand absent from this list is invisible to the measurement. p2_description_matches is the count of P2 notices the brand_regex matched on 16 September 2026, recorded so that a reader sees which entries did any work. provenance is stated per entry and not retrofitted: A, B and C are the sources C8 named or the sweep used; D is the author's market knowledge.
